contract: Flat JSON with every supplied P-label required exactly once, integer0-4, no additional keys. Reject duplicate raw JSON keys. No explanations.
evaluation: Paired same20-query baseline comparison when complete; otherwise explicit matched-success scope. Withhold incomplete graded comparisons. Compare v1 only on identical successfully ranked queries.
execution: First sorted sample query at each depth is a two-request smoke gate. Stop on any invalid smoke response. No retries; cached valid results are reused. Subsequent invalid answers are explicit, not fallback ranks.
hypothesis: Required fixed paper keys eliminate generated-permutation and note-ID errors; bounded usefulness scores enable deterministic client sorting.
interpretation: New scoring/tie contract, not an isolated output-format-only ablation. Scores are ranking signals, never evaluation grades or probabilities.
ranking: Descending model score; equal scores retain approved baseline order. Rerank only the supplied prefix and preserve the rest of the100 results.
scope: Exactly v1's20 queries, same baseline candidate10/50 and presentation order; full public title/authors/abstract. No extra queries, labels or held-out test.
